t: Design Asset Library - public implementations survey
title: Design Asset Library - public implementations survey
definition: Organizes reusable visual and interface assets.
description:
Design Asset Library is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Organizes reusable visual and interface assets. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Design Asset Library. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Design Asset Library. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Design Asset Library capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

definition of done is the Design Asset Library discipline: Organizes reusable visual and interface assets. It turns Design Asset Library from an event into a repeatable capability.

In practice this means: log every decision with its reason, so the next builder inherits understanding; verify outputs against the original request, not against your hopes; keep a failure log: what broke, why, and what now prevents it Teams that follow the discipline get predictable builds; teams that skip it get interesting stories. t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Design Asset Libr
title: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Design Asset Libr
definition: Ladder drill (foundation): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Design Asset Library from a one-paragraph brief.
description:
Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Design Asset Library from a one-paragraph brief

Read the brief twice. List every input the Design Asset Library needs, every output it must produce, and one contract each input-output pair must satisfy. Work it by hand first, then run the demo program and compare its trace against your own reasoning. When they agree, the concept is yours.

Success criterion: you can list them from memory without looking at the brief
